comment: The write side percent-encodes the field name and the read side does not, so any field whose name contains a space or punctuation is stored and never found again. Each file is correct in isolation; only the pair is wrong. Nothing here can be caught without cross-file context.

expect.what: loadDraft reads DRAFT_PREFIX + fieldName raw, while writer.js saveDraft writes DRAFT_PREFIX + encodeURIComponent(fieldName)
